title: Platform checklist: rewrite records-forms.master-detail-body-tables for the group-placed rule (a child is a tab by default; a parent field group draws it as a body table)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · this replaces #35846. Seat 4's area a4-I found its premise had moved (release comment 7074089131, analysis in the os-dev-report on #35701).
- #35846's done-when cites the 2026-11-20 ADR-0035 note of PR #35845, which the maintainer closed unmerged.
- After #35921, a master-detail child is a tab by default. It is drawn as a body table only where a field group of the parent names it (#35590).
- Reordering the old text would write another wrong assertion.

## Problem
`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`, item `records-forms.master-detail-body-tables`, still describes the old default in its title, its example, step 2 and its counter-example: every master-detail child is drawn as a body table in the overview.

## Done when
- The item states the rule on main:
  - A master-detail child is a related-list tab by default.
  - Where a field group of the parent names the child, the group draws the child's table at its place in the record's details.
  - The entry form inlines the child's rows there too.
  - A child that no group names stays a tab, whatever `inlineEdit` says.
- The example uses a showcase parent that already declares such a group. Name the object and the group, read from `examples/`.
- The counter-example is a child that no group names, shown as a tab.
- Sources cite #35921 and the spec's `fieldGroups[].relatedList`. They do not cite #35845.
- `records-forms.json` validates under the checklist's schema and lint, and no other item changes.

reach: the platform checklist item that runners execute; read against main by a4-I's dev.
Business reason: a checklist run against the old default fails a correct product, or passes a wrong one.
Reader: docs/qa (platform checklist).
Dedupe: `master-detail-body-tables`: #35846 only.
Grade: p3.
